Source: Brian Benchoff — Reverse Engineering the Nvidia SXM2 Socket
Canonical_Use: Connector A physical convention + PCIe/power/ground/reset + K18/K19 measured circuit
Key_Caveat: Minimal single-GPU carrier leaves many optional/management pins unconnected; NC means his carrier did not connect them, not necessarily that NVIDIA defines them NC.

Source: xinyuuliu Dual V100 SXM2→PCIe + NVLink 200GB project
Canonical_Use: Practical implementation cross-check for Benchoff Connector A; +5V A20:E20; K18/K19 circuit; NVLink data/clock cross-check
Key_Caveat: Raw EasyEDA column labels are source-view coordinates and must be mirrored into the canonical convention before comparison.

Source: mtf electronics studio — SXM2 to PCIe family
Type: Community reverse engineering + multiple tested board implementations / raw EDA
Canonical_Use: Complete Connector B NVHS map; additional Connector A sideband names; +5V implementation
Key_Caveat: Multiple revisions are one source family. Raw columns require the same normalization. Additional semantic labels remain community evidence, not official NVIDIA documentation.

Source: Community V100 SXM2→PCIe + ESP32 controller project
Canonical_Use: Supports interpretation that V100 EN is driven high and V100 temperature alert is monitored low-active
Key_Caveat: Supports semantics, not exact physical pad coordinates by itself.

Source: Facebook / QCT — Big Basin JBOG specification and GPU baseboard design files (Open Compute Project)
Type: Production reference design / schematic (NVIDIA DGX-1-derived baseboard)
Canonical_Use: SXM2 socket symbol pin names for connector A sideband, presence, reserved and ground contacts; connector B presence, SMBus and NVHS REFCLK polarity. Quanta S2W GPU baseboard schematic dated 2016-06-23, sheets 15–17.
Key_Caveat: Specification states the SXM2 baseboard 'leverages from the GPU Baseboard design of NVIDIA DGX-1 system'. Spec is offered under OCPHL-P v1.0; the separately downloaded design-file archive (https://www.opencompute.org/documents/designfiles-zip) carries no licence file, so it is cited, not bundled. P100-era design; the rev 1.0 spec states V100 SXM2 support. Pin coordinates use the same source frame as the MTF raw columns.

Source: OpenPOWER Foundation — Advanced Accelerator Adapter Electro-Mechanical Specification v1.0 (2017-11-08)
Canonical_Use: Sideband signal definitions, voltage levels and presence-detect loop behaviour for the shared 84740 two-connector layout.
Key_Caveat: Generic POWER9 adapter spec, not an NVIDIA document; it never names SXM2. Its ground/sideband layout matches SXM2 but it renames NVLink groups (OP0–OP5), leaves most PCIe positions RSVD and assigns INT_RST_N to a position the SXM2 reference grounds. Use for signal semantics, not SXM2-specific assignments.
